x: The handicap was won by one of our up and coming lads, Bob Phillips, with that improving youngster Ray Middleton, 3rd and "Evergreen" Doub. splitting them for 2nd place.

In our 7 miles Junior Race for the Horwood Cup we had a field of 25 and Eric Hall, improving every time out,had a good race with Bob Phillips and beat him down Lauriston Road to win in 58mins. 25secs. egged on over the last 100 yards by an enthusiastic band of runners returning from the common.
Bob Phillips was second in the handicap and our "A" team won the handicap team race and were 3rd in the Scratch Race, a good performance by all concerned.

This was held at Eltham on February 6th and we were unfortunately short of two of our qualified members, so that when Bob Phillips came under the judges' ban after the first mile our hopes of a place looked very slender.

No club finished their eight starters, but as we lost Mcgreechan in the 5 miles and Bob Phillips in the 2, we were severely handicapped. George Checkley was 2nd in the 5 miles, Syd James 2nd in 4 miles, George Beecham 5th in 4 miles, up and coming Ray Middleton 4th and George Oliver 6th in the 3 mil…
Bob Phillips, holder of the Surrey two miles title could be a winner. What about getting down to it Bob with the same determination as the other two.

He's certainly got some weight to get rid of before he is fit and we look forward to seeing him more regularly now he has finished his National Service. Bob Phillips, last year's runner up was not a starter.
